visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md (locked 2026-08-11). The index.html in this directory is the RETIRED KB-era mockup and is kept only because ci:mockup-coverage requires a parity.json beside any index.html. It is not the visual target. /buy has no inventory, so it opens on Stage (owned photo) then Ledger, Quiet, Sheet. Four of the six, no two adjacent alike.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic buyer-intent pages: live MLS search as the next step, a specific process walkthrough, buyer strategy sub-pages, and a listing-alerts ask. Zero invented stats.
note: E-HOMES-SEARCH 2026-08-13. Migrated /buy onto the v3 barrel. Chrome: layout mounts V3Chrome (sticky, in flow). This page does not remount it. V3Breadcrumb tone=on-media overlays the Stage (ci:kb-breadcrumb-overlay). V3Footer outside <main>. Page contract carried unchanged: pageMetadata title/description/path, revalidate 300, getSurfaceImage hero, BreadcrumbList + WebPage + FAQPage JSON-LD, KbSectionTracker pageType=buy, listing-alert capture via submitSearchAlertSignup (email + propertyType A + company honeypot), exits to /homes-for-sale, /buy/[intent], /open-houses, /price-drops, /contact. Dual objectives unchanged. KB-era deletions: SmoothScrollProvider, KbBreadcrumb, KbFooter, kb-root, kb.css, RegionalSfrAlertsBand / KbCommunityAlerts markup, six hero chips (Search homes stays as the Stage primary; the rest moved to the closing Quiet), the no-hand-off pitch. MetadataBlock and KbSectionTracker stay on non-v3 registers (JSON-LD + analytics, not visual language). /buy/[intent] still renders LeadLandingPage and is out of this lease.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: JSON-LD — BreadcrumbList + WebPage + FAQPage (canonical). V3Breadcrumb and V3Quiet carry no structured data of their own.

requiredComponents.name: KbSectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: Page-level analytics, pageType='buy'. Kept on the KB register: section tracking is analytics wiring, not visual language, and the barrel ships no equivalent.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Home > Buy, tone=on-media, belowNav=false, over the Stage photo. Chrome is sticky in flow so the trail does not need the fixed-header offset.

requiredComponents.name: V3Stage
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 4, once, heading level 1. Owned photo from getSurfaceImage. Headline keeps the money-route head term. Primary action: Search homes → /homes-for-sale. At 390 the chrome CTA sits in the menu, so this is the visible filled control in the first viewport.

requiredComponents.name: V3Ledger
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 3, once: first-time, relocation, and investment guides. Every row is a door into /buy/[intent].

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6, twice: how a purchase works (facts + the same FAQ items the FAQPage JSON-LD uses), then exits. Sheet sits between them so two Quiets are not adjacent.

requiredComponents.name: BuyAlertsSheet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 5, once, in app/buy/_v3/BuyAlertsSheet.client.tsx. Wraps V3Sheet and calls submitSearchAlertSignup with email + filters.propertyType A + company honeypot. Guest-watch residual and alert_create stay.

layoutComponents.name: V3Chrome
layoutComponents.section: renders from app/layout.tsx, position:sticky in flow
layoutComponents.note: ci:mockup-parity auto-satisfies a V3Chrome requiredComponent via layout. This page does not remount it.
